## Batch 40 handoff

The A page now documents the library’s Poisson bracket sign convention, moment-map hypotheses, and connectedness limits. The B page routes readers to five existing proved examples and counterexamples; it does not duplicate their carriers. I left the batch manifest’s item lists empty, following the current design’s “reuse only” and “no new mathematical items” scope.

I added [source coverage](research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-40.source-coverage.json) and [batch notes](research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-40.notes.md). The notes record the plan/design discrepancy, supplier checks, and unresolved handoff items. The three full-text treatments were fetch-verified: [Cannas da Silva](https://www.math.ist.utl.pt/~acannas/Books/symplectic.pdf), [Meinrenken](https://www.math.utoronto.ca/mein/teaching/LectureNotes/symplectic.pdf), and [Moshayedi](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2012.14662).

## Checks and blockers

- Scoped `rendercheck` passed for both pages. `source-fetch-check` passed for all 3 sources.
- The current read-only dependency recomputation keeps batch 40 at level 1 with prerequisite batch 32. The shared schedule check reports a stale input hash; I left that owner-controlled file unchanged.
- `item-dependency-levels` found 140 empty inventories among 162 pages, including both batch 40 pages. The empty inventory follows this pair’s current design but conflicts with Step 1’s nonempty-inventory acceptance requirement. The pair is **not ready**; no item decisions or proof-layout checks apply because no items were authored.
- Batch 32’s manifest now lists two A-page items, but its page body remains an empty draft scaffold. No Poisson claim here depends on those items; the page-order prerequisite remains unverified.

Owner reconciliation is needed for the item-inventory scope and the stale shared schedule input. The reviewed [batch 40 manifest](research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-40.pages.json) remains unchanged.
